description: This file defines the AndroidRunConfigurationType class, which implements the ConfigurationType interface for Android run configurations in an IDE, including nested factory class and configuration details.

classes.name: AndroidRunConfigurationType
classes.description: Implements ConfigurationType for Android run configurations, providing factory creation, display info, and icon.

classes.name: AndroidRunConfigurationFactory
classes.description: Nested class extending ConfigurationFactory, responsible for creating run configuration templates and applying default settings.

methods.name: createTemplateConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new AndroidRunConfiguration instance for a given project.

methods.name: canConfigurationBeSingleton
methods.description: Indicates whether the configuration can be a singleton; returns false.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the project has Android facets to determine applicability.

methods.name: configureBeforeRunTaskDefaults
methods.description: Disables the default compile step for Android Studio when applicable.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of AndroidRunConfigurationType.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name for the configuration type.

methods.name: getConfigurationTypeDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the configuration type.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with the configuration type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID string for the configuration type.

methods.name: getConfigurationFactories
methods.description: Returns the array of configuration factories associated with this type.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns the specific factory instance used to create configurations.
